title: 第七章功成出关

content_zh:
数万年的修炼终于是让玄元的苦功有了回报。寂静了十万多年的山谷终于出现了动静，只见一位身着青色长衫，面貌平凡，年约二十的青年从山谷中飞出，屹立山巅，环视四周，眼中颇不平静，“闭关了十万多年，道场变化倒是很大，如今出关，不过也算是功德圆满了！”长叹一声，却是心情十分愉悦。
蓬莱仙岛，仙气缭绕，生机盎然，各种奇珍异兽在岛上栖息，奇花异草争相开放，真是一处不可多得的仙境。晴空万里，水泊荡漾，此时，在岛中心的仙湖水面上，一青衣赤足，黑发飞扬的青年正静静地站在水面上，双目紧闭，却不影响其神异之处，青年周身隐隐散发出恐怖的气息，但又若有若无，可是玄妙无比，似要将自己融入天地端的是一个得道仙人之景。这青年自然是玄元道尊了，一眼望去仙风道骨，宛如天上谪仙，又似一个平凡的山村青年却又充满岁月沧桑之感，他的身影宛如融入空间之中，看似就在眼前却又现在未知的时空之中，他像是完全和天地合一，又如他就是一个天地一样。玄元闭关十万多年，终于从造化青莲中悟出自己的功法，今日出关，站在此处，心神不由得融入自然，心境竟然有了隐隐提升。
“看来收获不错，如今的修为已经达到了玄仙巅峰，半步金仙了！距离金仙之境也只是差了一个锲机，到时将能一举突破成为金仙大能了。”扫视了一下自身，玄元喃喃自语到。是的，经过了这么多年的修炼，玄元的修为增长十分迅速，如今已达玄仙巅峰，随时可突破入金仙，到时候就是洪荒之中的一方强者了。
玄元本身的元神道行都已经超过了金仙境界，差的也只是功法与法力了，而如今功法已成，又处在蓬莱这个灵气浓郁的道场中，修炼进境可是比别人快了很多倍，今日出关是因为知道金仙境界可不是靠简单的苦修就能突破的，而是需要锲机才能突破。因为到了金仙境界，就开始领悟法则，比之之前的境界要困难得多。因此，玄元也不再打算继续闭关，而是出来看看有没有机缘。“以我如今的实力，即使遇到金仙大能也可自保有余了，说不定突破的锲机就在外面。”玄元想到。
对于自身的实力，玄元可是相当有自信的，闭关中的他可不止创造了修炼功法，还有攻击之法等，其威力十分恐怖，这也是玄元的信心所在。十数万年的感悟与推演，玄元创造出自身的功法，名为无量衍天功，是以造化法则以及大道感悟，结合自身所创，其内包含万千，不仅有自己的功法，还包含炼器、炼丹、阵法等内容，可以说是包罗万象的功法大全了。其中的功法无量衍天诀是自己的修炼功法，可以修炼到太乙金仙境界，太乙之后的功法以他如今的实力还不能推演出来，只能随着自己实力的提升才能创造出来，但也是了不得的存在了，要知道洪荒中，太乙金仙也就几人而已，达到金仙的也就数十人，为何，还不是没有修炼功法，能创造出功法的也不会随意传给别人，因此，现在的洪荒虽然生灵无数，但修炼有成的也不过万里取一，更不要说金仙太乙金仙之能了，像洪荒凶兽，在没有开启灵智之前，也只是凭着本能吸收天地灵气，追寻强大的力量，也是没有修炼功法的，只有开启了灵智，才能获得混沌魔神的一些修炼记忆，真正的修行。
而且玄元也不只是创造出元神境界的修炼之法，连炼体的法门也创造出来了，要知道仙道中人几乎都不注重肉身修炼，只修元神，但玄元可知道一个强大的肉身可是可以提升自己很大战力的，像洪荒凶兽就是肉身强大无比，与同境界的人交战往往能占据上风，后来的十二祖巫更是以肉体为主，其强大连圣人都忌惮，比如十二祖巫肉身堪比极品先天灵宝，甚至更强，联手布成大阵，三清等圣人也不敢招惹。因此玄元可不会忽略这一方面，而且他心中有一个疯狂大胆的计划，，玄元不仅要走元神成道的道路，更要同时肉身成道，若能成功，说不定其成就能直追盘古大神，这绝对是一个疯狂的想法，要知道三千大道中可没有肉身成道的说法，但也不是没有方法，据说盘古大神也走肉身成道的路，而且走得很远，十二祖巫便是继承了这一方面的天赋才走上这一道路的。由此可见这一方法是行得通的，但是却十分困难，只能靠自己摸索。

content_en:
Tens of thousands of years of practice finally paid off for Xuanyuan's hard work. The valley that had been silent for more than 100,000 years finally started to move. A young man of about 20 years old, wearing a blue gown and an ordinary face, flew out of the valley, stood on the top of the mountain, and looked around. His eyes were quite uneasy. "After more than 100,000 years of seclusion, the Taoist temple has changed a lot. Now that I am out of seclusion, my merits are complete!" He sighed, but he was in a very happy mood.
Penglai Fairy Island is surrounded by fairy spirit and full of vitality. All kinds of rare and exotic animals live on the island, and exotic flowers and plants are blooming. It is really a rare fairyland. The sky is clear and the water is rippling. At this time, on the water of the Fairy Lake in the center of the island, a barefoot young man in green clothes with flying black hair is standing quietly on the water. His eyes are closed, but it does not affect his magic. There is a faint aura of terror around the young man, but it is still there, but it is extremely mysterious. It seems that he is integrating himself into the scene of an enlightened immortal at the end of the world. This young man is naturally Taoist Xuanyuan. At a glance, he looks like an immortal in the sky, but also like an ordinary mountain village youth but full of vicissitudes of time. His figure seems to blend into the space. He seems to be right in front of you but is now unknown in time and space. He seems to be completely one with the heaven and earth, and as if he is the same world. Xuanyuan has been in seclusion for more than 100,000 years, and finally understood his own skills from the green lotus of creation. Today, when he came out of seclusion and stood here, his mind could not help but blend into nature, and his state of mind actually improved slightly.
"It seems that the harvest has been good. Now my cultivation level has reached the peak of Xuanxian, half step of Golden Immortal! I am only one step away from the realm of Golden Immortal. By then, I will be able to break through and become a powerful Golden Immortal." After glancing at himself, Xuanyuan murmured to himself. Yes, after so many years of practice, Xuanyuan's cultivation level has grown very rapidly. Now he has reached the peak of Xuanxian, and can break through to Golden Immortal at any time. By then, he will be a strong person in the ancient times.
Xuanyuan's own spiritual skills have already surpassed the Golden Immortal Realm. The only difference is his skills and mana. Now that his Kung Fu has been completed, and he is in Penglai, a dojo with rich aura, his cultivation progress is many times faster than others. The reason he left today is because he knows that the Golden Immortal Realm cannot be broken through simple hard work, but requires hard work to break through. Because when you reach the Golden Immortal realm, you begin to understand the laws, which is much more difficult than the previous realm. Therefore, Xuanyuan no longer planned to continue in retreat, but came out to see if there was any chance. "With my current strength, I can still protect myself even if I encounter the powerful Golden Immortal. Maybe the key to a breakthrough is outside." Xuanyuan thought.
Xuanyuan is quite confident about his own strength. In seclusion, he not only created cultivation techniques, but also attack methods. Their power is very terrifying, which is where Xuanyuan's confidence lies. After tens of thousands of years of enlightenment and deduction, Xuanyuan created his own technique, called Wuliang Tian Gong, which was created based on his own understanding of the laws of creation and the Great Dao. It contains thousands of techniques, including not only his own techniques, but also weapon refining, alchemy, formations, etc. It can be said to be an all-encompassing collection of techniques. Among them, the Infinite Expansion Technique is his own cultivation technique, which can be cultivated to the realm of Taiyi Golden Immortal. The techniques after Taiyi cannot be deduced with his current strength, and can only be created as his strength improves. However, it is also an extraordinary existence. You must know that in the ancient times, there were only a few people in Taiyi Golden Immortal, and there were only dozens of people who reached the level of Golden Immortal. Why, not yet Without practicing Kung Fu, those who can create Kung Fu will not pass it on to others at will. Therefore, although there are countless living beings in the prehistoric era, those who have succeeded in cultivation are only one in ten thousand, let alone the ability of the Golden Immortal Taiyi Golden Immortal. Like the ferocious beasts in the prehistoric era, before their spiritual wisdom was opened, they only relied on instinct to absorb the spiritual energy of the world and pursue powerful power. They also did not practice Kung Fu.Only by opening up the spiritual wisdom can one obtain some of the training memories of the Chaos Demon God and achieve true cultivation.
Moreover, Xuanyuan not only created the method of cultivation in the realm of Yuan Shen, but also created the method of body training. You must know that almost people in the immortal way do not pay attention to physical training and only cultivate the Yuan Shen. But Xuanyuan knows that a powerful physical body can improve one's combat power, like the fierce beasts of the prehistoric times. The physical body is extremely powerful, and they often have the upper hand in battles with people of the same realm. The later Twelve Ancestral Witches are mainly based on the physical body, and their power is even feared by saints. For example, the physical body of the Twelve Ancestral Witches is comparable to the best innate spiritual treasures, or even stronger. They join forces to form a large formation, and Sanqing and other saints do not dare to provoke them. Therefore, Xuanyuan will not ignore this aspect, and he has a crazy and bold plan in his heart. Xuanyuan not only wants to follow the path of enlightenment as a soul, but also wants to become enlightened in the body at the same time. If he succeeds, his achievements may be able to catch up with the great god Pangu. This is definitely a crazy person. Crazy thoughts, you must know that there is no such thing as physical enlightenment in the Three Thousand Avenues, but it is not without methods. It is said that the Great God Pangu also took the road of physical enlightenment, and went very far. The Twelve Ancestral Witches inherited this talent and embarked on this path. It can be seen that this method is feasible, but it is very difficult and you can only explore it by yourself.
